comments: 8d484868: ;Call the line editor.

bb950e4c: ;Set up variable values needed for ^DIE call. DIE and DP point to the
 ;VENDOR PRODUCT FILE (#393). DL=1 indicates to edit just one entry.
 ;DIEL=0 means not to update audit trail, and DU=null means to display
 ;fields sequentially. Quit if there are no multiple entries.
0fc1219f: ;If a vendor product description exists, store it in DE(1) for editing.
ee0f42f8: ;Clean up variables and quit.
6e43d4b7: ;Write prompt with field label and colon.
070c3627: ;Return after writing prompt.
c064b6ca: ;Call reader to get response, echo if response fits on line.

24a83c32: ;If response is longer than 19 characters and field is word-processing,
 ;free-text or MUMPS code, branch to handle word-wrapping.

77675e1b: ;If field is read-only, display message and quit without allowing
 ;editing.

6f628945: ;Read response into X, timing out after DTIME seconds. If timed out,
 ;set X=U and DTOUT=1. Beep terminal.
1f59404d: Quit
be728a66: Increment DQ
27854c34: Branch to the routine specified by the incremented DQ
bab2679c: If DE(DQ) is defined, go to the PR label. Otherwise, execute W and TR.
2d6446b3: If X is empty and DV doesn't contain 'R', go to A. If X is empty and DV contains 'R', go to X. If D is less than or equal to 0, go to X. Otherwise, go to A.
833a22ce: If X starts with '?', go to QS. If X contains '^', execute D and goto ^DIE17.
6534e9bc: If X is '@', execute D and goto Z^DIE2.
4292d75f: If X is a space, DV contains 'd' but not 'P', and ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB) exists, set X to the value of ^(DLB). If DV doesn't contain 'D' or 'S', write '  ' followed by X.

dff32ccf: If DV is defined, go to M^DIE17. If DV contains 'V', go to ^DIE3. If DV doesn't contain 'S', go to P. If ^DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1) is defined, execute it. Set % to the portion of DU after the ';' and before the ';' matching X. Set Y to X. If % is not empty and DIC("S") is defined, execute DIC("S"). If DIC("S") is true and DB(DQ) is not defined, write '  ' followed by %.
80fe24c6: ;Execute validation routine if specified and quit if validation fails.
fb5d004e: ;Write the external value if the node does not exist, and set X to the internal value.
8192cc5a: ;If the DV doesn't contain a '*', call the DIC routine to validate or look up the value. Store the resulting internal value in X and set DIC=DIE. Quit if the lookup failed.
7be99933: ;If the DV doesn't contain 'N', validate the input using the D subroutine. If the input has more than 24 decimal places, kill X and go to the Z label.
7188fdde: Handle formatting and parsing of decimal numbers. Strip leading zeros, remove trailing zeros after decimal point, and convert numbers with decimal points but no fractional part to integers.
c9e89f58: ;Kill YS
bd6e85b6: ;If X is defined and not empty, save it in DG(DW). If DV includes a 'd', set ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB) to X. Go to label A.
009383df: ;If DB(DQ) is defined, go to label Z^DIE17. Otherwise, write a beep character and double question mark.
75df8305: ;Set X to the string "?BAD"
5313d5d0: ;Set DZ to X. Call D and QQ^DIEQ. Go to label B.
6b8ab585: ;Set D to DIFLD, and DQ(DQ) to the concatenation of DLB, U, DV, U, DU, U, DW, U, and the second piece of the line label X_DQ. Return.
942131c0: ;If DE(DQ) is not defined, call O and go to label RD if X does not contain "@", A if DV does not include "R" and X is "@", or X if X is "@". Otherwise, set X to Y and go to label N.
d56bf501: Invoke MUMPS code if sub-node 2 exists; otherwise, continue normal processing

f069e59b: If processing a pointer to a file, retrieve the pointed-to file number and global root. If data exists for the entry being referenced (^DD), set X to the input transform and DG to the output transform; otherwise, process as before.

f07bdb6f: If processing an input variable that contains a global reference, retrieve the pointed-to file number and subscript into the global. If data exists for the entry being referenced (^DD), set DG to the output transform and X to the input transform; otherwise, process as before.
5a6c8faa: If input string contains 'D', call ^DD('DD'), else if it contains 'S', set Y to substring of X after semi-colon.
560da793: If X is empty, set X to the default value in DE(DQ) array. If DV is true, go to label A. If DC is less than 2, go to label A, else go to label N^DIE17.
c314035d: If DV does not contain 'I' or '#', go to label RD.
f1d16f7c: Call E^DIE0. If X is defined, go to label RD, else go to label PR.
7cced0fd: Quit.
a30bfa90: Initialize variables DNM='DGJXE13' and DQ=1.
780cd545: Set DW='DT;5', DV='DX', DU='', DLB='DATE SIGNED', DIFLD=10.05.
a88fe71e: Perform variable kill and transfer execution to the RE label
eef01f63: Retrieve system date, store it in Y, and if Y is less than 1, kill X
e6d44edf: Exit the routine

5427ea7d: If DG exists and is greater than 9, call the F^DIE17 routine to update the file, set Y to the up-arrow character, DQ to 2, and call the X2 label; if Y is undefined or equal to up-arrow, go to label A; otherwise, set X to Y, DIC(0) to 'F', DW to DQ, and call the OUT^DIE17 routine
cfd9cccd: Blanks out the date transcribed field if the date dictated field is blank.
4fba6844: Quits the current block.
78ebe037: Validates the date dictated field. If the input is valid, it continues with the DATA ENTRY process. If the input is invalid, it quits the DATA ENTRY process.
4db3333b: Validates the date dictated field. If the date is before the DATE DICTATED, it displays an error message and blanks out the DATE TRANSCRIBED field.
3f31ed81: Quits the current block.
e1195c90: Validates the TRANSCRIPTION STATUS field. If the input is valid, it continues with the DATA ENTRY process. If the input is invalid, it quits the DATA ENTRY process.
6a28cdae: If the TRANSCRIPTION STATUS field is blank, it sets the value to 'TRANSCRIBED'.
f46425ab: Quits the current block.
0b174af3: Continues to the next phase of the DATA ENTRY process.
